newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen falling after sharp Dow decline.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen falling after sharp Dow decline.

text.p: Danish share prices opened virtually unchanged on Friday, but dealers foresaw more falls ahead on the Dow decline in New York, next week's FOMC and the run-up to the Easter break, due to start next Wednesday night with leading players away from the market.
"It won't take much for us to fall again today and the expiry of the KFX March future at noon isn't going to help matters. It should be a quieter day though with not so much panic," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained a marginal 0.10 point to 153.85 at 0820 gmt, having closed a hefty 4.28 point down on Thursday.
